demo.code:
You:   Show my Punk Town crew and rewards
Bankr: You have 2 active Crew positions and claimable AAPLc + GOOGLc.
       Position #42 is Surge; position #57 is Maximum.

You:   Settle everything and claim it to my Bankr wallet
Bankr: Settle positions #42 and #57 to your beneficiary credit on Base? (yes/no)
You:   yes
Bankr: Settled. Next fresh step: claim 14.82 AAPLc to 0xYourBankrWallet? (yes/no)
You:   yes
Bankr: Claimed 14.82 AAPLc. GOOGLc is the next separately confirmed step.
       Tx: basescan.org/tx/0x…

setup: Install the skill from the public GitHub repository URL
Use the active Bankr EVM wallet on Base; never paste or expose a private key
Keep Wallet API read-write access and arbitrary contract calls enabled for writes
Run the bundled live self-test once after install or update
Every write verifies the pinned deployment, emits one unsigned transaction, confirms that fresh step, and waits for a mined successful receipt before continuing
